{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-2","id":"msg_011Cgt6tnNZMR3fjf5k2aEu4","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_012eKKRqH86idbJsfYmks3HL","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cd /tmp/w && cat > b.sql <<'EOF'\nWITH ws AS (\n  SELECT wordid, synsetid, COUNT(*) AS c\n  FROM senses\n  GROUP BY wordid, synsetid\n),\nagg AS (\n  SELECT\n    ws.wordid AS wordid,\n    COUNT(*) AS total_synsets,\n    SUM(ws.c) AS total_senses,\n    COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS distinct_domains,\n    COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS distinct_posids,\n    MAX(ws.c * 4294967296 - ws.synsetid) AS m\n  FROM ws\n  CROSS JOIN synsets syn ON syn.synsetid = ws.synsetid\n  GROUP BY ws.wordid\n  HAVING total_synsets >= 2 AND distinct_domains >= 2\n  ORDER BY total_senses DESC, total_synsets DESC, distinct_domains DESC, ws.wordid ASC\n  LIMIT 500\n)\nSELECT\n  a.wordid AS word_id,\n  w.word AS word,\n  a.total_synsets,\n  a.total_senses,\n  a.distinct_domains,\n  a.distinct_posids,\n  (a.m + 4294967295) / 4294967296 * 4294967296 - a.m AS top_synsetid,\n  (a.m + 4294967295) / 4294967296 AS top_synset_sense_count\nFROM agg a\nJOIN words w ON w.wordid = a.wordid\nORDER BY a.total_senses DESC, a.total_synsets DESC, a.distinct_domains DESC, a.wordid ASC;\nEOF\nsed 's/syn.synsetid = ws.synsetid/syn.rowid = ws.synsetid/' b.sql > b2.sql\nfor f in b b2; hp.synsetid) AS m\n  FROM synsets syn\n  CROSS JOIN hp ON hp.synsetid = syn.synsetid\n  GROUP BY hp.wordid\n  HAVING total_synsets >= 2 AND distinct_domains >= 2\n),\ncold AS (\n  SELECT\n    cp.wordid AS wordid,\n    COUNT(*) AS total_synsets,\n    SUM(cp.c) AS total_senses,\n    COUNT(DISTINCT cp.domainid) AS distinct_domains,\n    COUNT(DISTINCT cp.posid) AS distinct_posids,\n    MAX(cp.c * 4294967296 - cp.synsetid) AS m\n  FROM (\n    SELECT s.wordid AS wordid, s.synsetid AS synsetid, COUNT(*) AS c, syn.domainid AS domainid, syn.posid AS posid\n    FROM senses s\n    CROSS JOIN synsets syn ON syn.synsetid = s.synsetid\n    WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hot WHERE total_senses >= (SELECT t FROM thr)) < 500\n      AND s.wordid IN (SELECT wordid FROM tot WHERE n < (SELECT t FROM thr))\n    GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid\n  ) cp\n  GROUP BY cp.wordid\n  HAVING total_synsets >= 2 AND distinct_domains >= 2\n),\nagg AS (\n  SELECT wordid, total_synsets, total_senses, distinct_domains, distinct_posids, m\n  FROM (SELECT * FROM hot UNION ALL SELECT * FROM cold)\n  ORDER BY total_senses DESC, total_synsets DESC, distinct_domains DESC, wordid ASC\n  LIMIT 500\n)\nSELECT\n  a.wordid AS word_id,\n  w.word AS word,\n  a.total_synsets AS total_synsets,\n  a.total_senses AS total_senses,\n  a.distinct_domains AS distinct_domains,\n  a.distinct_posids AS distinct_posids,\n  (a.m + 4294967295) / 4294967296 * 4294967296 - a.m AS top_synsetid,\n  (a.m + 4294967295) / 4294967296 AS top_synset_sense_count\nFROM agg a\nJOIN words w ON w.wordid = a.wordid\nORDER BY a.total_senses DESC, a.total_synsets DESC, a.distinct_domains DESC, a.wordid ASC;\nEOF\nsqlite3 -readonly -header /app/oewn.sqlite < /app/sol.sql > sol.txt; sqlite3 -readonly -header /app/oewn.sqlite < /app/my-sql-query.sql > orig_h.txt & \nsqlite3 -readonly /app/oewn.sqlite < /app/sol.sql | cmp - <<'EOF'\nimport sqlite3\nc = sqlite3.connect('file:/app/oewn.sqlite?mode=ro', uri=True)\na = c.execute(open('/app/sol.sql').read()).fetchall()\nexp = [tuple(l.rstrip('\\n').split('|')) for l in open('/tmp/orig.txt')]\nprint(len(a), [tuple(map(str,r)) for r in a] == exp, {type(x).__name__ for r in a for x in r})\nEOF","description":"Write solution, verify main and fallback paths against original output, and time it"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":713,"cache_read_input_tokens":62323,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":713,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"0ad400f5-d1e0-432d-996e-b27eafe9ff88","uuid":"0ddb3c17-83c7-44b4-a953-d1588adf649c","timestamp":"2026-11-09T22:04:11.032Z","request_id":"req_011Cgt7NsMUaHtm5oFJsXCh7"}
